title: LIBRA: Programmatic Induction of Executable Tool Libraries
abstract: arXiv:2611.05445v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Large language model agents increasingly retrieve tools from large catalogs, yet most retrievers rank each tool independently by request similarity. For multi tool tasks, this recovers the goal matching tool while omitting prerequisite tools required by the workflow.We introduce LIBRA, a framework for Library Induction by Runtime Assembly that turns a flat tool catalog into an executable tool library. An LLM proposes per tool contracts of candidate invocations, reusable outputs and state changes, and success conditions; LIBRA then tests these compositions in a sandbox and retains the relations supported at runtime. Constructed before user queries, the library requires no dependency annotations, tool use trajectories, or task specific training, and supports both one-shot and agentic retrieval. On AppWorld, BFCL, and SciToolEval, LIBRA improves one-shot Recall and NDCG over the same dense retriever by 7.9 and 3.7 percentage points on ave

translated_title: LIBRA：可执行工具库的程序化归纳
translated_abstract: 大型语言模型智能体越来越多地从庞大的工具目录中检索工具，然而大多数检索器仅根据请求相似度对每个工具进行独立排序。对于多工具任务，这种方式只能召回与目标匹配的工具，而遗漏了工作流程所需的先决工具。我们提出 LIBRA——一个通过运行时组装进行工具库归纳的框架，它将扁平的工具目录转化为可执行的工具库。大语言模型为每个工具提出契约，包括候选调用、可复用输出与状态变更以及成功条件；LIBRA 随后在沙盒环境中测试这些组合，并保留在运行时得到验证支持的工具间关系。该工具库在用户查询之前构建完成，无需依赖关系标注、工具使用轨迹或任务特定训练，同时支持一次性检索和智能体式检索。在 AppWorld、BFCL 和 SciToolEval 三个基准上，相比相同的稠密检索器，LIBRA 将一次性检索的 Recall 和 NDCG 平均提升了 7.9 和 3.7 个百分点。
tldr: LIBRA 通过让大语言模型提出工具间契约并在沙盒中进行运行时验证，将扁平的工具目录自动归纳为可执行的工具库，从而在多工具任务中检索出包含先决工具的完整工作流，无需依赖标注或任务特定训练，在多个基准上显著提升了检索性能。
en_tdlr: LIBRA programmatically induces an executable tool library from a flat tool catalog by having an LLM propose inter-tool contracts validated at runtime in a sandbox, enabling retrieval of complete workflows with prerequisite tools for multi-tool tasks without dependency annotations or task-specific training.
